Author

Harshini Karthikeyan, Alex Ralston, Jack Colt, Chelsey Harper

Code 
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(lubridate)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggforce)
library(igraph)
devtools::load_all("../")
Code 
org_edge <- read_csv("org_edge_scores.csv")
Code 
# Plot PZPR Edge CB Score over time

pzpr_edgecb_plot <- 
  org_edge |> 
  filter(Org.ID == "ORG01768") |> 
    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = Start.Date,
                       y = EB_month_cross)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .75) +
  # geom_point() +
  labs(title = 'PZPR Orgs Edge-CB Score Over Time',
       x = 'Year', 
       y = 'Edge CB Score',
       color = '') +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12))

pzpr_edgecb_plot
Code 
pzpr_edgecb_plot <- org_edge |>  
  filter(Org.ID == "ORG01768") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Start.Date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = EB_month_cross,   color = "Cross-betweenness"),
            linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_line(aes(y = EB_month_std,         
                color = "Edge betweenness"),
            linewidth = 0.75) +
  labs(title = "PZPR org – edge scores over time",
       x = "Year", y = "Score", color = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Cross-betweenness" = "steelblue",
                                "Edge betweenness"   = "firebrick")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12))

pzpr_edgecb_plot
Code 
apj_edgecb_plot <- org_edge |>  
  filter(Org.ID == "ORG02006") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Start.Date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = EB_month_cross,   color = "Cross-betweenness"),
            linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_line(aes(y = EB_month_std,         
                color = "Edge betweenness"),
            linewidth = 0.75) +
  labs(title = "APJ org – edge scores over time",
       x = "Year", y = "Score", color = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Cross-betweenness" = "steelblue",
                                "Edge betweenness"   = "firebrick")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12))

apj_edgecb_plot
Code 
org_meta <- read_csv("../clean_data/organization_meta_info.csv")
Code 
org_edge_scores <- org_edge |> 
  left_join(org_meta)
Code 
## ---- Code A: simple overall mean by month ----
org_auc_month  <- org_edge %>% 
  group_by(Org.ID) %>% 
  summarise(AUC_month_mean = mean(EB_month_cross, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_months       = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

## ---- Code B: equal-weight yearly mean (your proposal) ----
org_auc_yearly <- org_edge %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(Start.Date)) %>% 
  group_by(Org.ID, Year) %>% 
  summarise(year_mean = mean(EB_month_cross, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups   = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(Org.ID) %>% 
  summarise(AUC_year_mean = mean(year_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_years        = n(),
            .groups = "drop")
Code 
org_auc_yearly <- org_auc_yearly |> 
  left_join(org_meta)
Code 
org_auc_yearly |> arrange(desc(AUC_year_mean)) |> 
  slice_max(order_by = AUC_year_mean, n = 50) |> 
  kable(format = "html", caption = "Highest 20 Aggregated Edge-CB Results") |> 
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = F)

```{r}
org_meta <- read_csv("../clean_data/organization_meta_info.csv")

```
```{r}
org_edge_scores <- org_edge |> 
  left_join(org_meta) 
```

```{r}
## ---- Code A: simple overall mean by month ----
org_auc_month  <- org_edge %>% 
  group_by(Org.ID) %>% 
  summarise(AUC_month_mean = mean(EB_month_cross, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_months       = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

## ---- Code B: equal-weight yearly mean (your proposal) ----
org_auc_yearly <- org_edge %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(Start.Date)) %>% 
  group_by(Org.ID, Year) %>% 
  summarise(year_mean = mean(EB_month_cross, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups   = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(Org.ID) %>% 
  summarise(AUC_year_mean = mean(year_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_years        = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

```


```{r}
org_auc_yearly <- org_auc_yearly |> 
  left_join(org_meta) 
```


```{r}
org_auc_yearly |> arrange(desc(AUC_year_mean)) |> 
  slice_max(order_by = AUC_year_mean, n = 50) |> 
  kable(format = "html", caption = "Highest 20 Aggregated Edge-CB Results") |> 
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = F)
```
